fact: The party discovered the remains of a drow, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins suspended inside a gelatinous cube.
source_quote: the party discovered the remains of a drow, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins apparently hovering above the floor. The objects were suspended inside a gelatinous cube
subject: discovery of suspended objects

fact: The drow remains are suspended inside the gelatinous cube and are nearly digested.
source_quote: The drow suspended inside him is nearly digested.
subject: drow remains

fact: A dark metal mace is suspended inside the gelatinous cube.
source_quote: the party discovered the remains of a drow, a dark metal mace
subject: dark metal mace

fact: Scattered coins are suspended inside the gelatinous cube.
source_quote: the party discovered the remains of a drow, a dark metal mace, and scattered coins
subject: scattered coins

fact: The gelatinous cube has two visible eyes.
source_quote: The objects were suspended inside a gelatinous cube with two visible eyes.
subject: gelatinous cube

fact: Glabbagool greeted the party by saying, “Well, hello, hello, hello.”
source_quote: the cube greeted them: “Well, hello, hello, hello.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool introduced himself to the party.
source_quote: He introduced himself as Glabbagool
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool was previously an average garden variety gelatinous cube.
source_quote: he had been “an average garden variety gelatinous cube,”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: As a normal cube, Glabbagool moved around cleaning floors and decomposing items left behind by adventurers.
source_quote: moving around, cleaning floors, and decomposing whatever adventurers left behind.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool recently gained the ability to think and see.
source_quote: Now, inexplicably, he could think and see.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool is fascinated by the implications of his sentience.
source_quote: Glabbagool was fascinated by the implications of sentience.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool admits he knows little about the world.
source_quote: he readily admitted that he knew little about the world.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool does not know which route leads upward.
source_quote: He also had no idea which route led upward
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool had spent much of his sentient life standing in place and deciding where to go.
source_quote: having spent much of his brief sentient life standing in place and deciding where to go.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Thorin invited Glabbagool to join the expedition.
source_quote: Thorin invited him to join the expedition
subject: Thorin invites Glabbagool

fact: Thorin promised Glabbagool companionship, adventure, and a reliable supply of food.
source_quote: promising companionship, adventure, and a reliable supply of food.
subject: Thorin's offer

fact: Glabbagool accepted the invitation to join the party.
source_quote: Glabbagool accepted
subject: Glabbagool joins party

fact: Glabbagool asked if the party would be upset if he ate them after they died.
source_quote: he politely asked, “You won’t be upset if you all die and I eat you, right?”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The party agreed that they would not be upset if Glabbagool ate them once they were dead.
source_quote: The party agreed that once they were dead they would probably be past caring
subject: party's answer

fact: Glabbagool insists he would never want to promote the party's demise.
source_quote: Glabbagool insists he would never want to promote their demise.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The party agreed that Glabbagool can eat them provided natural causes do the killing.
source_quote: provided Glabbagool allowed natural causes to do the killing.
subject: eating condition

fact: Gyrgum tossed Glabbagool a lucky foot he had been carrying in his backpack.
source_quote: Gyrgum tossed Glabbagool a lucky foot that he had been carrying in his backpack.
subject: lucky foot gift

fact: The lucky foot came from an unidentified creature.
source_quote: The party admits uncertainty over what creature the foot originally came from.
subject: lucky foot

fact: Glabbagool absorbed the lucky foot.
source_quote: The cube absorbed it
subject: Glabbagool eats foot

fact: Glabbagool declared the lucky foot tasty.
source_quote: declared it tasty.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool offered to eat any unwanted objects dropped on the floor.
source_quote: Glabbagool also offered a standing service to the party: “If you ever decide you want to get rid of something, just drop it on the floor and I’ll be happy to eat it.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The party decided against feeding Glabbagool the ghost bones because the associated ghost reacts angrily.
source_quote: The party decides against feeding him the ghost bones because the associated ghost reacts angrily.
subject: ghost bones rejection

fact: Glabbagool is surprised to learn that sentient beings differ in intelligence and awareness.
source_quote: Glabbagool is surprised to learn that sentient beings differ in intelligence and awareness
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool thought everybody was sentient in the same way.
source_quote: “I thought everybody was sentient in the same way.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool has noticed rising water and considers it awkward.
source_quote: Glabbagool has noticed the rising water and considers it awkward
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool has no suggestion for avoiding the rising water.
source_quote: but he has no suggestion for avoiding it.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool is excited about talking to Thorin.
source_quote: Glabbagool joins the expedition and becomes especially excited about talking to his new friend Thorin.
